description: Turns a market thesis, capital, and risk tolerance into a risk-sized Hyperliquid perp plan (ENTER/WAIT/NO_TRADE, entry, stop, targets, size, leverage cap). Use when you have a thesis and a budget; for a no-input single-coin setup use `hl_quick_trade_idea`; paid 3.3 USDC via x402.

examples.marketThesis: ETH holding support after a pullback; expecting a bounce if BTC stays firm.

capitalUsdc.description: Capital in USDC. Size is a 0.5%, 1%, or 2% risk fraction of this amount, by riskTolerance.

direction.description: auto (default) reads the thesis, then falls back to the higher-timeframe trend.

market.description: Optional Hyperliquid perp symbol. Unlisted symbols are rejected with suggestions.

marketThesis.description: What you expect to move and why (10-2000 chars). Name the market here if you omit market.

riskTolerance.description: conservative: 0.5% risk, max 2x. moderate: 1% risk, max 3x. aggressive: 2% risk, max 5x, also capped by the market max.

name: trade_strategy_consult

alternatives.description: Opposite-side setup and the breakout trigger setup.

direction.description: long or short, and directionSource explains why.

entryZone.description: Entry price range (ATR + swing-structure based), or the trigger that would create one.

invalidation.description: Price/trend condition that invalidates the plan.

leverageSuggestion.description: Lowest leverage that fits the size, capped by risk profile (2/3/5x) and liquidation buffer.

marketContext.description: Mark, funding APR, open interest, 24h volume and per-timeframe trend/ATR/RSI/EMA/support/resistance from Hyperliquid candles, plus recent headlines.

observedAt.description: UTC time the data was read.

plan.description: All numbers: entry low/high/ref, stop, TP1/TP2, stop distance (% and ATR), risk budget, notional, size, margin, leverage, est. liquidation price, max loss incl. fees.

rationale.description: Reasoning behind every level and the verdict; AI write-up added when available.

sizeRecommendation.description: Position size in coins and USDC notional, margin, leverage and the USDC risked at the stop.

tpSlLevels.description: stopLoss, takeProfit (TP1), takeProfit2 and their risk:reward multiples.

trigger.description: Breakout/breakdown condition with entry, stop and TP1 if price confirms.

verdict.description: ENTER = setup valid now; WAIT = levels given but conditions not met (see trigger); NO_TRADE = cannot be sized safely (e.g. stop too wide for the risk budget or below HL's $10 minimum).

title: Trade Strategy Consult
